observables.name: internal_vent_photo
observables.method: Take clear internal photos showing the vents and surrounding area
observables.accepts: vents are clear from racks, cable trays, fiber troughs, or any installed equipment that could restrict airflow

observables.name: external_vent_photo
observables.method: Verify externally that vents are visible and not obstructed by external infrastructure, cabling, or environmental debris
observables.accepts: vents are visible and not obstructed by external infrastructure, cabling, or environmental debris

citation_span: Verify externally that HVAC intake/exhaust vents are visible and not obstructed by external infrastructure, cabling, or environmental debris. Verify internally that HVAC intake and return vents are clear from racks, cable trays, fiber troughs, or any installed equipment that could restrict airflow.

observables.name: vent_clearance_measurement
observables.target: distance from HVAC supply and return vents to any obstruction
observables.method: Measure the clearance from the vent to the nearest obstruction

citation_span: Must maintain 30 - 36 inches of clearance from HVAC supply and return vents.

observables.name: unit_spacing_photo
observables.target: HVAC units and their side vents and maintenance panels
observables.method: Take a photo showing the spacing between HVAC units and access to side vents and maintenance panels
observables.accepts: side vents and maintenance panels are accessible, not blocked by adjacent units

citation_span: Do not install HVAC units too close together, preventing access to side vents or maintenance panels, as per Manufaturers Standards
notes: Manufacturer's standards referenced but not provided; spacing must allow access to side vents and panels.

observables.name: vent_area_photo
observables.method: Take a photo showing the area around the vents to confirm no equipment, materials, or storage items are near
observables.accepts: no equipment, materials, or storage items are placed near vents

citation_span: Do not place equipment, materials, or storage items near vents.
Do not ignore blocked airflow conditions as they can affect equipment cooling.

observables.name: network_connection_screenshot
observables.target: network connection status of the HVAC controller
observables.method: Capture a screenshot showing the device is connected to the network
observables.instrument: network management console or device interface

observables.name: ip_address_screenshot
observables.target: assigned IP address of the HVAC controller
observables.method: Capture a clear screenshot showing the assigned IP address, including date/time, full screen, not cropped, not edited
observables.accepts: IP address is fully visible and readable, screenshot includes date/time, not blurred, not cropped too tightly, not edited

citation_span: HVAC System Controller Remote Communication: Verify the device(s) is IP enabled and remotely accessible from an IP address. Ensure the device is connected to the network and accessible via the interface. Capture a clear screenshot showing the assigned IP address.

observables.name: ip_address_screenshot
observables.method: Capture a screenshot showing the IP address and verify it matches the expected network range
observables.accepts: IP address is valid and matches the expected network range

citation_span: Verify the IP address is valid and matches the expected network range.
notes: Expected network range not specified in document; must be obtained from site network plan.

observables.name: status_screenshot
observables.target: system status and alarm relay status
observables.method: Capture a screenshot showing the system status is active/online and the unit is alarm free
observables.accepts: system status is active/online and unit is alarm free as per Alarm Relay Status

citation_span: Confirm the system status is active/online, and the unit is alarm free as per the Alarm Relay Status shown above.

observables.name: screenshot_quality_review
observables.method: Review the screenshot to ensure it is not blurred, low-quality, incomplete, unrelated, or edited; ensure IP address is fully visible and readable; ensure entire screen or relevant section is captured; ensure date/time is included
observables.accepts: screenshot is clear, complete, shows network/IP details, includes date/time, and is not edited

citation_span: Do not use blurred, low-quality, or incomplete screenshots. Do not capture unrelated screens that do not show network/IP details. Do not edit or alter the screenshot content.
notes: Screenshot quality requirements are derived from Don'ts and Do's.
